title: HR Recruiter
description:
**Company:** Capstone Technologies LLC / AJ Capstone Infotech Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:** Kochi, Kerala (On\-site)

**Position Type:** Full\-time

**Experience Level:** 2–5\+ Years in AEC/BIM/Engineering Recruitment \& HR Operations

About Capstone Technologies

Capstone Technologies is a global engineering consultancy specializing in Building Information Modeling (BIM), Architectural, Structural, MEP Design, and Digital Transformation solutions. We partner with leading AEC (Architecture, Engineering \& Construction), Infrastructure, and Energy sector clients across the US, UAE, Saudi Arabia, and India.

Role Overview

We are looking for a dynamic **HR Recruiter** with hands\-on experience in **Engineering / AEC recruitment** to join our Kochi office. The ideal candidate should possess a strong understanding of technical AEC roles—such as BIM Modelers (Architecture, Structure, MEP), MEP Coordinators, CAD Technicians, and Structural Engineers—along with practical experience in end\-to\-end HR operations, employee onboarding, and vendor management.

Key Responsibilities  
Talent Acquisition \& Sourcing

* End\-to\-end recruitment cycle management: sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer rollout, and negotiation for specialized AEC and BIM positions.
* Source passive and active candidates through **LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri** industry networks, and campus placements.
* Design targeted Boolean search strings to source niche profiles like **MEP BIM Coordinators, Revit Modelers, Civil 3D Engineers, and Structural Designers**.
* Conduct initial HR screening rounds to evaluate domain affinity, communication skills, technical background, and salary expectations.
* Coordinate technical assessments and client/internal manager interview rounds.

HR Operations \& Candidate Management

* Manage employee onboarding, document verification, background checks, and orientation processes for new hires.
* Maintain complete candidate databases (ATS/Excel trackers) and generate weekly sourcing/time\-to\-hire reports.
* Handle core HR operational duties including attendance management, employee query resolution, and leave tracking.

Qualifications \& Key Requirements

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources (MBA HR preferred) or related fields.
* 2 to 5 years of talent acquisition experience, primarily within **AEC, Construction, BIM Services, or Core Engineering** domains.
* Understanding of BIM/AEC software stack terminology (Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, ArchiCAD, Creo) to effectively screen engineering profiles.
* Familiarity with Indian labor compliance, payroll coordination basics, and employee lifecycle management.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Proficient with job portals, social recruiting platforms, and HR tools.

Interested candidates can share their updated CV to **recruiter.kochi@capstonees.com** with the subject line: **"Application for HR Recruiter \- Kochi"**.

Pay: From ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Assistant Manager - Talent Acquisition
description:
Malabar Group is seeking a dynamic and results\-driven **Assistant Manager Talent Acquisition** to lead and execute end\-to\-end recruitment activities for retail operations. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in **core talent acquisition**, particularly within the **retail industry**, and possess excellent stakeholder management and sourcing capabilities.

**Role \& responsibilities** :

* Manage the **end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle** (sourcing to onboarding) for critical and mid\-level retail roles.
* Drive hiring for **retail positions** such as Sales Executives, Store Managers, Cluster Managers, and support roles.
* Implement innovative sourcing strategies using **job portals, social media, referrals, walk\-ins, and campus hiring**.
* Build and maintain a strong **talent pipeline** for ongoing and future requirements.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements and deliver timely closures.
* Ensure a seamless and **positive candidate experience** throughout the recruitment journey.
* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of **Talent Acquisition Executives/Recruiters**.
* Allocate hiring requisitions and monitor individual/team performance against **KPIs and hiring targets**.
* Track recruitment metrics and generate reports on **time\-to\-hire, cost\-per\-hire, and hiring effectiveness**.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and recruitment best practices.
* Support employer branding initiatives and participate in hiring events, job fairs, and retail hiring campaigns.

**Requirements:**

* **6 to 8 years** of experience in **core Talent Acquisition / Recruitment**.
* Masters Degree (MBA/PGDM in HR or related field) is preferred .
* Mandatory experience in **retail hiring** (preferably in large retail chains, FMCG retail, jewelry, or lifestyle sectors).
* Proven experience in **team handling along with direct hiring responsibility**.
* Strong understanding of **retail recruitment lifecycle and bulk hiring**.
* Proven ability to manage **high\-volume hiring** within tight deadlines.
* Excellent **communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills**.
* Familiarity with **ATS tools and job portals** (Naukri, LinkedIn, etc.).
* Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment.

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Kochi, Kerala: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Education:

* Master's (Required)

Experience:

* Retail hiring : 4 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Purplle Hiring Hr executive For Kochi
description:
Job Description – Off\-Roll Recruiter

Company: Purplle

Hiring Partner: AasaanJobs

Role: Recruiter – Beauty Adviser Hiring

Employment Type: Off\-Roll / Contract

Location: Kerala

Department: Talent Acquisition

About Purplle

Purplle is a leading beauty and personal\-care platform with a growing retail store network across Kerala. We are looking for an energetic recruiter to support high\-volume hiring for our Beauty Adviser (BA) positions across multiple store locations.

Role Overview

The Recruiter will be responsible for sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, and driving candidates through the hiring process until joining.

Key Responsibilities

Source candidates for Beauty Adviser positions across Kerala.

Handle high\-volume recruitment requirements for multiple Purplle stores.

Source candidates through:

Job portals

WhatsApp groups

Social media

Employee referrals

Local candidate networks

Colleges / institutes

Other recruitment channels

Screen candidates based on eligibility, communication skills, grooming, sales orientation, location and experience.

Conduct initial telephonic screening and explain the job role, salary, location, shift timings and benefits.

Coordinate candidate interviews with the Purplle HR / Store team.

Maintain regular follow\-up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.

Ensure selected candidates complete documentation and joining formalities.

Drive offer\-to\-joining conversion and minimize candidate dropouts.

Maintain daily recruitment trackers with:

Profiles sourced

Profiles screened

Interviews scheduled

Candidates selected

Offers released

Candidates joined

Dropouts / rejections

Provide regular recruitment status updates to the Purplle HR team.

Maintain a ready pipeline of candidates for current and upcoming store vacancies.

Coordinate with candidates regarding joining date, location and reporting details.

Candidate Requirements

6 months–2 years of experience in recruitment / talent acquisition preferred.

Experience in volume hiring, retail hiring, sales hiring or frontline recruitment will be an advantage.

Freshers with strong communication and sourcing skills may also be considered.

Good communication skills in Malayalam and English.

Strong follow\-up and candidate\-handling skills.

Comfortable working with recruitment targets and multiple vacancies.

Basic knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets and recruitment portals.

Should be proactive, target\-oriented and comfortable with frequent candidate calls.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with experience hiring for:

Beauty / Cosmetics

Retail

Sales

Beauty Adviser

Customer Service

Frontline / Blue\-collar positions

FMCG / Fashion / Lifestyle retail

will be preferred.

Key Performance Indicators

Number of qualified profiles sourced

Screening\-to\-interview ratio

Interview\-to\-selection ratio

Offer\-to\-joining conversion

Joining TAT

Candidate retention / early dropout

Closure of assigned vacancies within agreed timelines

Working Arrangement

Employment: Off\-Roll through AasaanJobs

Client: Purplle

Hiring: Beauty Adviser – Kerala

Work Mode: Recruitment / sourcing focused

Target: High\-volume frontline hiring

Why Join?

Opportunity to work on recruitment for a leading beauty retail brand.

Exposure to high\-volume retail recruitment.

Opportunity to work with a fast\-growing store network.

Performance\-driven recruitment environment.

Hands\-on experience in end\-to\-end frontline hiring.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹28,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
